description: Pixelate any photo with an adjustable block size and download the result.

faqs.a: The image is drawn tiny (one pixel per block) and then scaled back up with smoothing disabled, which produces the classic mosaic pixelation effect.
Yes — larger blocks mean bigger pixels and stronger anonymization, which is handy for hiding faces or license plates.
faqs.q: Can I use this to anonymize faces?

faqs.a: No. Your image is processed locally in your browser and never uploaded anywhere.

howto: Choose an image file from your device.
Drag the block-size slider (4–64 px) to set the pixel size.
title: Image Pixelator
